density: Raw native density; appearance remap .75*d+.12*max(d,0)^1.35 is separate
velocity: XYZ components sampled on their own exported grids; do not assume collocation
sampling: Index-to-world matrices map continuous voxel-centre indices to metres. Trilinear scalar sampling, outside0; velocity assembled from three independently sampled components. Linear interpolation between adjacent timestamped fields; times outside0..4 are an explicit caller decision, default reader rejects.
encoding: Per-field gzip of headerless little-endian float32; X fastest, then Y, then Z. Lossless byte conversion, no spatial or time resampling.
